result.markdown:
# Nationwide Slow Data and Traffic Dip Due to Core DNS Degradation

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** core_degradation at `CORE-DNS-01`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct telemetry anomalies, matching DNS failure signature, major alarm on CORE-DNS-01 matching KPI onset time, though maintenance calendar was not checked.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-27 09:30 to 2026-09-27 11:30
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-27 09:30
- **Affected:** CORE-DNS-01

## Summary

Core DNS node CORE-DNS-01 experienced a degradation with dropped query success percentage and spiked resolution times, causing nationwide slow data and a traffic dip.

Nationwide slow data and traffic dip starting at 09:30 and recovering at 11:30 on 2026-09-27.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-27 09:30: National dl_volume_mb below baseline and CORE-DNS-01 query_success_pct onset of deviation. [T2, T6]
- 2026-09-27 09:46: Major DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE raised on CORE-DNS-01. [ALM-000623]
- 2026-09-27 11:26: Major DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE cleared on CORE-DNS-01. [ALM-000623]
- 2026-09-27 11:30: CORE-DNS-01 query_success_pct and resolution_ms recovered. [T6]

## Evidence

- National dl_volume_mb and latency showed a deviation starting at 2026-09-27 09:30. [T2]
- CORE-DNS-01 query_success_pct dropped to a mean of 95.9 with a minimum of 85.2 at 2026-09-27 09:30. [T6]
- CORE-DNS-01 resolution_ms spiked to a mean of 29.3 with a maximum of 82.9 at 2026-09-27 09:30. [T6]
- Major alarm ALM-000623 for DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE was raised on CORE-DNS-01 at 2026-09-27 09:46 and cleared at 11:26. [ALM-000623]
- No changes were executed on any node between 2026-09-27 06:00 and 2026-09-27 12:00. [T4]
- Alert ALR-0039 was triggered from 2026-09-27 09:30 to 11:30 involving 40 sites and CORE-DNS-01. [ALR-0039]

## Hypotheses

1. **core_degradation** at CORE-DNS-01: confirmed. CORE-DNS-01 experienced a major DNS degradation starting at 09:30 matching nationwide traffic drop and latency rise. [T2, T6, ALM-000623]
2. **bad_change**: rejected. No changes were recorded on any node during the incident window. [T4]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000619: Minor VSWR_HIGH on S-SUD-007 cleared before the incident window and affected only a single site.
- ALM-000620: Minor VSWR_HIGH on S-SUD-007 occurred before the incident and is localized.
- ALM-000624: Minor VSWR_HIGH on S-TUN-002 occurred after the incident recovery time.
- ALM-000625: Minor VSWR_HIGH on S-TUN-002 occurred after the incident recovery time.
- ALR-0041: Ongoing alert starting on 2026-09-28 affects a different scope and time period.

## Recommended actions

- Investigate the root cause of the query success drop on CORE-DNS-01.
- Review DNS resource capacity and scaling parameters during peak loads.
- Check the maintenance calendar to rule out planned work.

## Sources

- `T2`: query_kpis(entity_type=national, metrics=['dl_volume_mb', 'latency_ms'], start=2026-09-27 06:00, end=2026-09-27 13:00) -> Deviation in 2 of 2 series. Earliest onset 2026-09-27 09:30: NATIONAL dl_volume_mb below baseline.

- `ALM-000623`: major DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE on CORE-DNS-01, raised 2026-09-27 09:46, cleared 2026-09-27 11:26
- `T4`: get_changes(start=2026-09-27 06:00, end=2026-09-27 12:00, include_ancestors=True) -> No changes on any node between 2026-09-27 06:00 and 2026-09-27 12:00.
- `ALR-0039`: ended alert from 2026-09-27 09:30: 40 site(s) (S-SAH-001, S-SAH-002, S-SAH-003, S-SAH-004 +36 more); core CORE-DNS-01, CORE-UPF-01, CORE-UPF-02; region-level SAH, SFX,...
- `ALM-000619`: minor VSWR_HIGH on S-SUD-007, raised 2026-09-27 06:57, cleared 2026-09-27 07:05
- `ALM-000620`: minor VSWR_HIGH on S-SUD-007, raised 2026-09-27 07:38, cleared 2026-09-27 07:55
